body:
## Why
Since 12 Oct the app has run on Clerk (v2), and no new client has had `waitlist_date` set. In the old Bubble app the waitlist was a status (17) and the backend stamped the date when it saw it. In v2 the browser decides the waitlist and only moves the user to a `/waitlisted/*` page, so nothing is stored.

Worked example: v1 waitlisted 74 of 566 new clients (13.1%). v2 created 85 rows, so about 11 should be waitlisted, but the database shows 0. On test, client 11297 sending `client_status_id: 17` gets 409 `client_status_not_writable`; sending 2 gets 200 and leaves `waitlist_date` empty.

## What this changes
When the app sends a user to `/waitlisted/*`, it can now call one small route, `POST /api/clients/:client_id/waitlist`. For client 11297 the date is set the first time and a repeat call keeps the first date. The client's status is not touched, so the status rules and the ways off the waitlist stay as they are.

```text
Before: user routed to /waitlisted/* -> nothing stored -> waitlist_date empty
After:  user routed to /waitlisted/* -> POST /api/clients/11297/waitlist
        -> waitlist_date = now (first call only), status unchanged
```

## Technical details
- Problem: no v2 path writes `waitlist_date`; status 17 is not writable for Clerk callers.
- Fix:
  - `routes/clients.routes.js`: new route. 200 `{waitlist_date}` (UTC ISO), 400 bad id, 404 `client_not_found` for an unknown client and for a Clerk caller naming another user's client (the ownership check runs before any DB read). Service callers may act on any client. `UPDATE ... WHERE waitlist_date IS NULL`, so it is idempotent.
  - `utility/clerkRouteAllowlist.js`: route added (caller `profile/useRecordWaitlist`).
  - `swagger.yml`: path documented.
- Note: the first version returned 403 for another user's client, as first specified. The review found that 403 vs 404 reveals which client ids exist, so firstmate decided on 404 to match PUT and DELETE. The frontend only logs the status, so it does not depend on 403.
- Out of scope, follow-ups: `onboarding_date`, any status-17 edge in `utility/clientStatus.js`, backfilling old rows, reporting queries.
- Proof:
  - `make integration-test ARGS="--testPathPatterns=clientWaitlist"`: red before the route (5 of 7 failed), green after.
  - `npx jest test/routes`: 146 passed.
  - Local-stack proof: below.

## Local-stack proof
Backend run locally (`HTTP_PORT=8099 ENV=test node server.js`) against the test Postgres and test Clerk, with env from the `applypass-backend-test` vault. Clerk sessions minted with `node scripts/get-dev-token.js <email>` for the donotdelete accounts `uday+e2e-donotdelete-w0` and `-w1` (clients 10535 and 10536). JWTs are not shown. The `waitlist_date` column is shown as stored text (UTC). The stored value 21:05:27.316698 matches the API's `2026-11-22T21:05:27.316Z`. After the proof, both rows were reset to `waitlist_date = NULL`.

```text
$ DB before
[{"client_id":10535,"client_status_id":2,"waitlist_date":"2026-11-2221:05:00.393725"},{"client_id":10536,"client_status_id":2,"waitlist_date":null}]
$ POST /api/clients/10536/waitlist  (Clerk session of uday+e2e-donotdelete-w1, own client)
{"waitlist_date":"2026-11-22T21:05:27.316Z"} HTTP 200
$ DB after first call
[{"client_id":10535,"client_status_id":2,"waitlist_date":"2026-11-2221:05:00.393725"},{"client_id":10536,"client_status_id":2,"waitlist_date":"2026-11-2221:05:27.316698"}]
$ POST again (repeat)
{"waitlist_date":"2026-11-22T21:05:27.316Z"} HTTP 200
$ DB after repeat
[{"client_id":10535,"client_status_id":2,"waitlist_date":"2026-11-2221:05:00.393725"},{"client_id":10536,"client_status_id":2,"waitlist_date":"2026-11-2221:05:27.316698"}]
$ POST /api/clients/10535/waitlist with the w1 session (another user client)
(captured before the 404 change: {"error":"forbidden"} HTTP 403; it now answers 404 client_not_found, asserted in clientWaitlist.integration.test.js)
$ POST /api/clients/99999999/waitlist (unknown client)
{"error":"client_not_found"} HTTP 404
$ POST /api/clients/10536/waitlist (no auth)
{"error":"Unauthorized"} HTTP 401
```

## Reader and writer audit
Field: `client.waitlist_date`.
- Writers: this new route (sets it once when NULL); `POST /api/clients` and `PUT /api/clients/:client_id` (service callers; sets it when status 17 arrives; Clerk callers are refused it); no other change.
- Readers: `GET /api/clients`, `dataLayer/commonQueries.js` and reporting SQL read it unchanged. This PR adds no reader.

## Intent

Fix the missing waitlist tracking, shipped as a fix to dev.

Context from the investigation: since the 12 Oct move from the Bubble app (v1) to the Clerk app (v2), no new client ever gets `waitlist_date` set.
- v1: Bubble sent `client_status_id: 17` through `PUT /api/clients`, and the backend set `waitlist_date` (`routes/clients.routes.js` around lines 384-387 and 626-628).
- v2: the waitlist decision happens in the browser (`src/hooks/useWaitlistEvaluation.ts`, from market analysis, relocation choices and work authorization) and only changes the route to `/waitlisted/*`. `markOnboardingComplete()` (`src/lib/api/profile/useMarkOnboardingComplete.ts`) sends `client_status_id: 2` for everyone. Nothing records the waitlist.
- Repro on test with a Clerk session for test client 11297: `PUT /api/clients/11297 {client_status_id: 17}` returns 409 `client_status_not_writable`; `PUT {client_status_id: 2}` returns 200; the DB row then has status 2 and empty `waitlist_date`.
- Worked example: v1 waitlisted 74 of 566 new clients (13.1%). v2 created 85 rows, so about 11 waitlisted were expected; the DB shows 0.
- Agreed fix (Option A): when the app routes a user to `/waitlisted/*`, call one small backend route that sets `waitlist_date`. No new status, so the v2 status state machine and the leave-the-waitlist paths stay as they are. One backend route, one frontend call, one integration test.

## Risk Assessment

✅ Low: One new route sets waitlist_date only while it is NULL and never touches client_status_id, as Option A requires. The round-1 fix holds: the Clerk ownership check (routes/clients.routes.js:856) runs before any DB read and answers 404, the same way PUT (line 516) and DELETE (line 820) do. Example: client 11297 posting to /api/clients/500/waitlist gets 404 whether or not client 500 exists, and the test at line 86 checks those two answers match.

<summary>🔧 **Review** - 1 issue found → auto-fixed ✅</summary>

- ⚠️ `routes/clients.routes.js:853` - The route looks up the client row before it checks ownership, so a Clerk caller can tell whether any client_id exists. Example: client 11297 signs in with Clerk and posts to /api/clients/500/waitlist. They get 403 if client 500 exists and 404 if it does not, which lets them map every live client id. The sibling Clerk checks run before any DB read and answer 404 for a mismatch (PUT at routes/clients.routes.js:516, DELETE at routes/clients.routes.js:820). Fix: move the `authKind === 'clerk' && client_id !== Number(req.user.client_id)` check above the SELECT at line 849, so a Clerk caller never gets a lookup on someone else's id. The documented 403 for a mismatch can stay. Then change the test `answers 404 for a client that does not exist` (test/integration/clientWaitlist.integration.test.js:85) to use serviceToken(), because a Clerk caller would now get 403 for that id.

🔧 Fix applied.
✅ Re-checked - no issues remain.
